_comment: Single source of truth for Ritushka's price list. Derived from the Stage-4 forensic audit of the Australian abstract landscape/seascape market and her own recorded prices. See Australian Art Pricing Research/Ritushka_Pricing_Method.md. Change referenceRate here, re-run scripts/apply-pricing-model.py, then scripts/sync-register.py.
_referenceRate: AUD price of a 1.0 m2 work. Her own prices imply 4430 (list) and 4861 (achieved). 5400 = the recommended STEP, placing her at the median of the artist-direct band (P25 7993 / median 9281 / P75 9737 normalised to 100x200). 6400 would enter gallery-tier pricing and needs gallery representation or a prize result first.
_sizeExponent: price = referenceRate * area_m2 ^ exponent. From a within-artist log-log regression across 24 Australian artists, n=226 demeaned observations, R2=0.83. Doubling the area multiplies price by ~1.70, not 2.00. Do not change without new evidence.
_premiumSupportUplift: Applied when the register's Support / Substrate names linen. Her cost records: stretched canvas A$252/m2 vs Belgian linen A$522/m2.
_roundTo: Published prices are rounded to this multiple.
_priceSoldWorks: A sold work never carries a MODELLED list price: the modelled figure is not what the buyer paid, so apply-pricing-model.py skips sold rows. It does carry its ACHIEVED price, read straight from the register's Sale Price column by sync-register.py into Artwork.soldPrice and published on the artwork page, the sold archive and in schema.org as a SoldOut Offer. Nothing is modelled there — a sold work with no Sale Price recorded shows a plain 'Sold'.
_printSizeLongEdgeCm: Long-edge target per print tier, in cm, before the size-cap rule below is applied. See docs/prints-decisions.md Section 5.
_printSizeCapPercent: A print's long edge may never exceed this fraction of the original artwork's own long edge. A tier whose target long edge exceeds the cap for a given artwork is not offered for that work (e.g. Large is dropped for a 60x60cm original). Original-protection rule, not a pricing input.
_printEditionSize: Fixed edition size per tier, same for every artwork. Each tier is its own independently numbered edition (n / N), never shared across tiers. See docs/prints-decisions.md Section 4.
_printTierPercent: print price = referenceRate * areaM2^sizeExponent * printTierPercent[tier], then rounded to roundTo. Reuses the existing size-scaling curve (referenceRate/sizeExponent above) purely as a fair relative-scaling reference between print sizes -- NOT a claim that a print is worth this fraction of an equivalent original. Rises with scarcity (smaller edition = higher percent). Margin-checked in docs/prints-decisions.md Section 6 against estimated Australian giclee production costs; re-check against a real print-lab quote before relying on it for launch pricing.
